description:
## Finding

jmap-chat-server's Cargo.toml has NO \`[package.metadata.docs.rs]\`
block and NO \`#[cfg_attr(docsrs, doc(cfg(feature = \"memory\")))]\`
annotations on the feature-gated \`memory\` module.

Default features for chat-server is empty (no \`default = [...]\`).
Consequence: docs.rs builds chat-server with default features,
which means **the entire \`memory::MemoryBackend\` reference impl
is invisible on docs.rs**.

## Why this contradicts the crate's own invitation

The crate's own lib.rs explicitly tells readers to look at the
gated module. From src/lib.rs lines 19-27:

> Enable the \`memory\` feature to expose the
> \`memory::MemoryBackend\` reference implementation. The
> reference impl is in-memory only and explicitly NOT
> production-grade...

A reader following that pointer on docs.rs lands on a
\"module not found\" page. The contract gap: chat-server's docs
direct consumers to a module the rendered docs do not show.

This bites chat-server harder than most siblings because the
\`memory::MemoryBackend\` reference impl is part of the kit's
stated deliverable (workspace AGENTS.md \"What this workspace
builds\" — \"reference \`MemoryBackend\` impls\"). The kit ships
this as a public artifact and then conceals it on its public
doc page.

## Workspace context

Verified absent across ALL 32 workspace crates: zero hits for
\`package.metadata.docs.rs\` or \`cfg_attr(docsrs\` workspace-wide.
This is workspace-canonical (not a chat-server local drift), but
the bite point — \"the docs.rs page contradicts the lib.rs doc\"
— is felt most on the extension-server crates because they all
gate their reference backends behind \`feature = \"memory\"\`.

## Recommendation

Add to Cargo.toml:

```toml
[package.metadata.docs.rs]
all-features = true
rustdoc-args = [\"--cfg\", \"docsrs\"]
```

And add to gated items in src/lib.rs:

```rust
#[cfg(feature = \"memory\")]
#[cfg_attr(docsrs, doc(cfg(feature = \"memory\")))]
pub mod memory;
```

(Same pattern for any other gated items.) This is the standard
docs.rs feature-gate pattern. The matching \`#[cfg(docsrs)]\` cfg
makes the gate visible as a badge in rendered docs.

## Propagation note

Workspace-wide gap. A fix for chat-server should land in
jmap-mail-server (the canonical extension-server template) first
per the AGENTS.md \"Canonical Templates\" propagation rule, then
propagate to all 8 extension-server crates and likely all 32
workspace crates.

## Engineering basis

Direct verification: \`grep -n \"package.metadata.docs.rs\\|cfg_attr(docsrs\"
crate-jmap-chat-server/Cargo.toml crate-jmap-chat-server/src/*.rs\`
returns zero hits. Workspace-wide grep returns zero hits.
title: API contract: docs.rs renders without 'memory' module — no [package.metadata.docs.rs] block, no #[cfg_attr(docsrs)] annotations
